name: QMT: Quality Magic Tester
source:
John receives a sketchy job opportunity to test objects. Magical objects. Will he be responsible or abuse the crap out of the ultimate power he just received?

[From [url=https://thextra.itch.io/qmt-quality-magic-tester]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
约翰收到了一个测试物体的粗略工作机会。神奇的物体。他会因为刚刚获得的终极权力而承担责任吗？还是会滥用权力？

[来自[url=https://thextra.itch.io/qmt-quality-magic-tester]Itch.io[/url]]
